cues.zh: 解说员：2008年2月7日晚上7点15分，
cues.en: Narrator: At 7:15 p.m. on February 7, 2008,

cues.zh: 一系列猛烈的糖粉爆炸摧毁了帝国糖业精炼厂，
cues.en: a series of violent sugar dust explosions devastated the Imperial Sugar Refinery

cues.zh: 该厂位于佐治亚州温特沃斯港，就在萨凡纳郊外。
cues.en: in Port Wentworth, Georgia, just outside Savannah.

cues.zh: 爆炸迅速蔓延至各栋建筑，
cues.en: Explosions raced through the buildings,

cues.zh: 燃料来自积聚的可燃糖粉以及从设备中溢出的糖。
cues.en: fueled by accumulations of combustible sugar dust and sugar that had spilled from equipment.

cues.zh: 厚重的混凝土地面被掀起，砖墙被炸飞进楼梯间和工作区，
cues.en: Thick concrete floors heaved up and brick walls were blown into stairwells and work areas,

cues.zh: 堵住了许多逃生通道。火势迅速蔓延。
cues.en: blocking many exit routes. Fires spread rapidly.

cues.zh: 解说员：八名工人在现场遇难。
cues.en: Narrator: Eight workers died at the scene.

cues.zh: 另有六人后来在区域烧伤中心不治身亡。
cues.en: Six more died later at a regional burn center.

cues.zh: 数十人受伤。
cues.en: Dozens of others were injured.

cues.zh: 该厂庞大的糖包装建筑全部损毁。
cues.en: The plant's massive sugar packing buildings were a total loss.

cues.zh: 布雷斯兰：帝国糖业这起事故是数十年来美国
cues.en: Bresland: The accident at Imperial Sugar was the deadliest industrial dust explosion

cues.zh: 最致命的工业粉尘爆炸。
cues.en: in the United States in decades.

cues.zh: 这凸显了可燃粉尘危害的极端严重性。
cues.en: It highlights the extremely serious nature of combustible dust hazards.

cues.zh: Vorderbrueggen：糖粉尘大量积聚，
cues.en: Vorderbrueggen: There were significant accumulations of sugar dust

cues.zh: 整个设施的表面都散落着颗粒状白糖。
cues.en: and spilled granulated sugar on surfaces throughout this facility.

cues.zh: 灾难性事故的条件已经具备。
cues.en: Conditions were set for a catastrophic accident.

cues.zh: 旁白：帝国糖业庞大的Port Wentworth厂区于1917年开始运营，
cues.en: Narrator: Imperial Sugar's sprawling Port Wentworth complex began operations in 1917

cues.zh: 并逐步发展成为美国最大的糖精炼和包装设施之一。
cues.en: and grew to become one of the largest sugar refining and packaging facilities in the U.S.

cues.zh: 精炼厂生产的颗粒状白糖储存在三座100英尺高的筒仓中，
cues.en: Granulated sugar from the refinery was stored in three 100-foot tall silos

cues.zh: 然后被输送到包装车间，在那里包装以便分销。
cues.en: and then conveyed into packing buildings, where it was packaged for distribution.

cues.zh: 颗粒状白糖还被加工成特种产品，如红糖和糖粉。
cues.en: Granulated sugar was also converted into specialty products, such as brown sugar and powdered sugar.

cues.zh: 糖通过由斗式提升机、螺旋输送机和传送带组成的复杂系统进行运输。
cues.en: Sugar was transported by a complex system of bucket elevators, screw conveyors and conveyor belts.

cues.zh: 在这个过程中，糖洒到了整个工作区的地面上。
cues.en: During this process, sugar spilled onto floors throughout the work area.

cues.zh: 有些地方，洒落的糖积了好几英寸厚。
cues.en: In places, the spilled sugar was many inches deep.

cues.zh: 这些糖还含有细微颗粒，会飘散到空气中。
cues.en: This sugar also contained fine particles, which became airborne.

cues.zh: 此外，工厂用锤式粉碎机把砂糖碾成糖粉，产生了更多粉尘。
cues.en: In addition, hammer mills were used to crush the granulated sugar into powdered sugar, creating even more dust.

cues.zh: 机器连接了除尘系统，但系统容量不足，而且年久失修。
cues.en: The machines were connected to a dust collection system, but it was undersized and in disrepair.

cues.zh: 而且它没有连接到斗式提升机和输送机上。
cues.en: And it was not connected to the bucket elevators and conveyors.

cues.zh: 大量糖粉尘逸散到了工作区域。
cues.en: Significant amounts of sugar dust escaped into the work areas.

cues.zh: 工人经常用压缩空气清洁包装机，
cues.en: Workers routinely used compressed air to clean packaging machines,

cues.zh: 这进一步让糖粉尘扩散到整栋建筑里。
cues.en: further dispersing sugar dust throughout the buildings.

cues.zh: 久而久之，大量粉尘积聚在高处难以清洁的表面上，
cues.en: Over time, large amounts of dust accumulated on elevated, hard-to-clean surfaces,

cues.zh: 比如管道、横梁和灯具。
cues.en: such as ducts, beams and light fixtures.

cues.zh: 这些表面没有足够频繁地清洁，无法始终将粉尘保持在危险水平以下。
cues.en: These surfaces were not cleaned often enough to always keep the dust below hazardous levels.

cues.zh: 在糖仓下方的隧道里，粒状糖通过溜槽流到一条长长的钢制传送带上。
cues.en: In the tunnel beneath the sugar silos, granulated sugar flowed through chutes onto a long steel conveyor belt.

cues.zh: 时不时地，糖块会卡在某个溜槽里，
cues.en: From time to time, clumps of sugar would become stuck in one of the chutes,

cues.zh: 阻碍传送带上的糖流，使糖洒落到地板上，并向隧道中释放粉尘。
cues.en: blocking the flow of sugar on the belt, spilling sugar onto the floor and releasing dust into the tunnel.

cues.zh: 但隧道很大且通风良好，因此这些空气中的粉尘没有积聚到爆炸性浓度。
cues.en: But the tunnel was large and ventilated, so this airborne dust did not build up to explosive concentrations.

cues.zh: 然而，2007年，该公司用不锈钢板将传送带封闭起来
cues.en: However, in 2007, the company enclosed the conveyor belt with stainless steel panels

cues.zh: 以保护糖免受可能的污染。
cues.en: to protect the sugar from possible contamination.

cues.zh: 该封闭装置没有配备粉尘收集系统。
cues.en: The enclosure was not equipped with a dust collection system.

cues.zh: 结果，糖粉尘现在会被困在这个封闭空间内。
cues.en: As a consequence, sugar dust would now be trapped inside this enclosure.

cues.zh: 2008年2月7日，人们发现糖块堵塞了一个排放槽。
cues.en: On February 7, 2008, clumps of sugar were found blocking one of the discharge chutes.

cues.zh: 邻近筒仓的糖可能从传送带上洒落。
cues.en: Sugar from the adjacent silo likely spilled off the moving belt.

cues.zh: 粉尘可能在封闭空间内积聚到爆炸性浓度。
cues.en: Dust likely accumulated to an explosive concentration inside the enclosure.

cues.zh: 当晚约7点15分，糖粉尘接触到附近的点火源——很可能是一个过热的轴承——随即发生爆炸。
cues.en: At about 7:15 p.m., the sugar dust contacted a nearby ignition source, likely an overheated bearing and exploded.

cues.zh: 这次初次爆炸炸开了封闭空间。[爆炸声]
cues.en: This primary explosion blew apart the enclosure. [Sound of explosions]

cues.zh: 并冲入包装车间。
cues.en: And vented into the packing building.

cues.zh: 积聚的糖被扬起，并被推进的火球点燃。[爆炸声]
cues.en: Accumulated sugar was lofted and ignited by the advancing fireballs. [Sound of explosion]

cues.zh: 粉尘云助长了二次爆炸的连锁反应……[爆炸声]
cues.en: The dust clouds fueled a chain reaction of secondary explosions ... [Sound of explosions]

cues.zh: 席卷了各栋建筑。
cues.en: which swept through the buildings.

cues.zh: 混凝土地板扭曲变形，将数吨砂糖和糖粉抛入火焰之中。
cues.en: Concrete floors buckled, releasing tons of granulated and powdered sugar into the flames.

cues.zh: 旁白：此前从未进行过紧急疏散演练
cues.en: Narrator: Emergency evacuation drills had not been conducted

cues.zh: 爆炸还切断了内部大部分照明电源。
cues.en: and the explosions had cut the power to much of the interior lighting.

cues.zh: 在漆黑受损的楼梯间和通道迷宫中，
cues.en: In the maze of darkened and damaged stairwells and passageways,

cues.zh: 工人们拼命逃离不断蔓延的火海。
cues.en: workers desperately tried to flee the growing inferno.

cues.zh: 旁白：CSB发现，早在20世纪50年代末的往来信件
cues.en: Narrator: The CSB found that correspondence dating back to the late 1950s

cues.zh: 就表明Port Wentworth的工厂经理们
cues.en: showed that plant managers in Port Wentworth

cues.zh: 已经知道糖粉尘的爆炸性和粉尘积聚的危险。
cues.en: were aware of the explosive nature of sugar dust and the danger of dust accumulations.

cues.zh: 早在1961年，一份备忘录就描述了一次糖粉尘爆炸，严重损毁了糖粉磨坊车间。
cues.en: As far back as 1961, a memo described a sugar dust explosion that heavily damaged the powdered sugar mill room.

cues.zh: Vorderbrueggen：尽管长期以来都清楚糖粉尘的爆炸性，
cues.en: Vorderbrueggen: Despite the longstanding awareness of the explosive nature of sugar dust,

cues.zh: 但在危害管理方面做得远远不够。
cues.en: not enough was done to manage the hazard.

cues.zh: 旁白：2006年，CSB发布了一项关于可燃粉尘的研究，
cues.en: Narrator: In 2006, the CSB issued a study of combustible dust,

cues.zh: 呼吁OSHA以美国国家消防协会（NFPA）的现行标准为基础，
cues.en: which called on OSHA to establish a comprehensive combustible dust standard,

cues.zh: 制定全面的可燃粉尘标准。
cues.en: based on the current standards of the National Fire Protection Association or NFPA.

cues.zh: 2007年10月，OSHA开始实施一项新的国家重点工作计划
cues.en: In October, 2007, OSHA began implementing a new National Emphasis Program

cues.zh: 以加强对现有可燃粉尘相关法规的执法力度。
cues.en: to increase the enforcement of existing regulations related to combustible dust.

cues.zh: Vorderbrueggen：帝国糖业在Port Wentworth灾难性爆炸发生前四个月
cues.en: Vorderbrueggen: Imperial Sugar learned of the OSHA Combustible Dust National Emphasis Program

cues.zh: 就得知了OSHA可燃粉尘国家重点工作计划。
cues.en: four months before the devastating explosion at Port Wentworth.

cues.zh: 但管理层并未有效采取措施控制包装车间严重的粉尘问题。
cues.en: But management did not act effectively to control the serious dust problem in the packing buildings.

cues.zh: 旁白：灾难发生前不到两个月，
cues.en: Narrator: Less than two months before the disaster,

cues.zh: 一次内部检查显示，仍有大量糖定期洒落到地面上。
cues.en: an internal inspection showed that many tons of sugar were still regularly spilling onto the floors.

cues.zh: 这为大规模二次爆炸和火灾提供了大量燃料。
cues.en: This provided much of the fuel for the massive secondary explosions and fires.

cues.zh: 旁白：CSB发现，多年来Port Wentworth工厂定期发生小规模火灾，
cues.en: Narrator: The CSB found that over the years, the Port Wentworth facility periodically experienced small fires,

cues.zh: 燃料来自洒落的糖和设备上积聚的粉尘。
cues.en: fueled by spilled sugar and accumulated dust on equipment.

cues.zh: 但没有一个导致糖粉爆炸并蔓延至整个工厂。
cues.en: But none resulted in a sugar dust explosion that propagated through the plant.

cues.zh: 旁白：调查人员表示，数十年来在没有发生灾难性爆炸的情况下运营
cues.en: Narrator: Investigators said that decades of operating without a catastrophic explosion

cues.zh: 可能让管理层放松了警惕，陷入自满。
cues.en: may have lulled managers into complacency.

cues.zh: 在报告中，CSB向帝国糖业公司提出了以下建议。
cues.en: In its report, the CSB issued the following recommendations to the Imperial Sugar Company.

cues.zh: 将NFPA标准应用于重建的Port Wentworth设施的设计和运营。
cues.en: Apply NFPA standards to the design and operation of the rebuilt Port Wentworth facility.

cues.zh: 制定并实施全面的可燃粉尘控制、清洁管理和培训计划。
cues.en: Develop and implement comprehensive combustible dust control, housekeeping and training programs.

cues.zh: 改进紧急疏散政策和程序。
cues.en: Improve emergency evacuation policies and procedures.

cues.zh: Bresland：企业可以通过遵循美国国家消防协会现有的建议
cues.en: Bresland: Companies can go a long way to control combustible dust within their own facilities

cues.zh: 在控制自身设施内的可燃粉尘方面取得很大成效。
cues.en: by following the existing recommendations of the National Fire Protection Association.

cues.zh: 但现在也是时候制定一项全面的联邦可燃粉尘标准了。
cues.en: But it is also time for a comprehensive federal standard on combustible dust.

cues.zh: 旁白：2009年4月，OSHA宣布计划就以下事项启动规则制定：
cues.en: Narrator: In April, 2009, OSHA announced plans to begin rulemaking on a

cues.zh: 针对一般工业的可燃粉尘标准。
cues.en: combustible dust standard for general industry.

cues.zh: 在关于帝国糖业事故的最终报告中，
cues.en: In its final report on the Imperial Sugar accident,

cues.zh: CSB建议OSHA迅速推进这项新标准。
cues.en: the CSB recommended that OSHA move forward expeditiously with the new standard.

cues.zh: Bresland：如果没有监管、执法和教育，
cues.en: Bresland: Without regulation, enforcement and education,

cues.zh: 工人将继续面临灾难性粉尘爆炸的风险。
cues.en: workers will continue to be at risk from catastrophic dust explosions.

cues.zh: 旁白：欲了解更多信息，请访问CSB.gov。
cues.en: Narrator: For further information, please visit CSB.gov.
